title: MidTool: Mid-training Data Synthesis for Agentic Tool Use
abstract: arXiv:2608.20314v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mid-training is increasingly recognized as a critical stage for shaping the capabilities of large language models. Recent work has shown that targeted mid-training can strengthen reasoning-intensive abilities such as math and science, and can also improve agentic capabilities in software-engineering settings. In this work, we study the parallel but less explored agentic capability: general tool use. We present MidTool, an open corpus construction pipeline for agentic tool-use mid-training that combines large-scale web, PDF, and code data with synthesized supervision from real-world tool APIs, MCP skills, and document-grounded workflows. MidTool is designed to teach models how to recognize tool affordances, ground arguments from context, compose tool call workflow, and recover from incomplete information. translated_title: MidTool：面向智能体工具使用的中期训练数据合成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20314v1 公告类型：新 摘要：中期训练日益被认为是塑造大型语言模型能力的关键阶段。近期研究表明，有针对性的中期训练可以增强推理密集型能力，如数学和科学，同时也能提升软件工程环境中的智能体能力。在这项工作中，我们研究了并行但较少探索的智能体能力：通用工具使用。我们提出了MidTool，一个用于智能体工具使用中期训练的开放语料库构建流程，该流程结合了大规模网页、PDF和代码数据，以及来自真实世界工具API、MCP技能和文档驱动工作流的合成监督。MidTool旨在教导模型如何识别工具功能、从上下文中提取参数、组合工具调用工作流，并从信息不完整中恢复。我们在MidTool-Mix上对Qwen3-4B-Base和Qwen3-8B-Base进行中期训练，然后应用后续的后训练，包括监督微调。
tldr: 本文提出了MidTool，一个结合大规模数据与合成监督的开放语料库构建流程，用于增强大型语言模型的通用工具使用能力，并通过中期训练有效提升模型在工具识别、参数提取、工作流组合和信息恢复方面的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MidTool, an open corpus construction pipeline that combines large-scale data with synthesized supervision to enhance general tool-use capabilities in large language models, improving tool recognition, argument grounding, workflow composition, and recovery from incomplete information through mid-training.
